provider: Derived locally from JMA Himawari-9 HSD / NOAA Open Data

recipe.scaling: Clip each channel to [0,1], multiply by 255 and round. Missing pixels transparent.
recipe.resampling: nearest neighbour; 5000 m radius; no temporal interpolation

limitations: Ash RGB assists interpretation but is not an ash mask, concentration measurement or cloud-top-height retrieval. Clouds, viewing angle and mixed pixels affect colours. Nominal scan times are not per-pixel acquisition times.
attribution: Created locally from Japan Meteorological Agency Himawari-9 data accessed through NOAA Open Data. Not an official JMA image product.
